items.text: Two programs are off track (school pilot install and ERPNext), and the school pilot delay is now holding up the investor update.
Portable unit launch: at risk. The Oct 31 launch holds, but partner 2's store staff will have less than a week of training.
School group pilot: off track. 8 of 12 classrooms installed; Block B waits on a landlord permit that could take 3 weeks.
Assessment service v2: on track and live. Report turnaround is down to 4 days from 9, and our units remove 99.99% of mold at customer sites.
ERPNext rollout: off track. The partner's sync fix failed again, technicians are double-entering jobs, and the partner says the fix is out of scope.
Q4 stock import: at risk. The shipment is held at customs; about 3 weeks of service parts remain and partner 2's launch stock is on the same shipment.
Field technician hiring: on track. Two technicians started Oct 5; the third role is in final interviews.
Investor update: at risk. The customer impact section waits on school pilot results due Oct 29, after the Oct 22 send date.
Approve air freight of 150 filters and 40 cells for an extra QAR 6,200 by Oct 19.
Decide whether to pay our own contractor QAR 9,500 to open the Block B ceilings.
By Oct 22, choose the investor update's impact source: the 9 villa and office results now, or wait for the school pilot and send in early November.
Confirm whether both retail partners launch together on Oct 31 or partner 1 goes first.
Decide whether to share early results at the school's parents' evening on Nov 5.
